subject: Web Development
title: Privacy vs. Personalization
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Privacy vs. Personalization.

hook.text: Users want personalized experiences but don't want companies tracking their every move.

buildup.text: Third-party cookies are dying. Chrome, Safari, and Firefox are blocking cross-site tracking.

discovery.text: Privacy Sandbox and Topics API try to enable ads without individual tracking.

twist.text: Advertisers worry that privacy kills their business model. Users worry the opposite isn't enough.

climax.text: The web must find a new balance between useful personalization and genuine privacy.

punchline.text: Privacy and relevance must learn to coexist.

quiz.question: What is happening to third-party cookies?
